generalCriterionList.description: The bidders fulfilling all rules/conditions said in the tender document are eligible. Latest Circulars from Govt. are also applicable.

As per tender Agreement clause 24.1, the successful tenderer shall submit the Security Deposit(Performance Security) infavour of Executive Engineer in the form of Bankers Cheque/Pay order for an amount of equivalent to 5% of the contract price and also an additional security for unbalanced tender amount in the form of FDR of any Nationalised Bank within 7 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance and shall enter into an agreement and the work shall be started within a week after agreement. The Name in the FDR/STAMP Paper as per Contractor License.

All the documents pertaining to technical bid should be attested by the gazetted officer not less than the grade of District Level Officer. If not said bid shall be rejected and he should be able to produce the attested document at any time, if required.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The contractor is supposed to purchase all required materials on his own for carrying out the work, and all the materials shall be tested for its quality prior to construction and its quality shall be of ISI standards.
An amount of 1% shall be deducted towards Labour Less from each of the running bill of the contractor.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable.
Conditional tenders are subjected for rejection.
Acceptance/Cancellation of the works are reserved by undersigned without any reasons for the same.

All bidders shall upload the details of the following documents: i) Contractor Registration. ii) Works completed in last 5 years. iii) Details of minimum quantities of work done in one year. iv) Yearly turnover from last 5 years. v) Present ongoing works. vi) Tener bid Capacity should be more than Tender amount

As per Director, Department of Mines and Geology Bengaluru Circular For the year 2023-24 dated: 07-11-2023, if the contractors fail to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit(MDP) along with the bill for the sub-minerals used for the works, action will be taken as per the said circular.

itemList.description: Providing and fixing Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular hollow tubes etc.) trusses etc., including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer, including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished seamless type tubes including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing & fixing corrugated G.S. sheet roofing including vertical / curved surface fixed with polymer coated J or L hooks, bolts and nuts 8 mm diameter with bitumen and G.I. limpet washers or with G.I. limpet washers filled with white lead, including a coat of approved steel primer and two coats of approved paint on overlapping of sheets complete as per design drawings (up to any pitch in horizontal/ vertical or curved surfaces), excluding the cost of purlins, rafters and trusses  and including cutting to size and shape wherever required as per the direction of Engineer in charge.0.63 mm thick with zinc coating not less than 275 g/ m²

Providing and fixing precoated galvanised steel sheet roofing accessories 0.50 mm (+0.05 %) total coated thickness, Zinc coating 120 g/m2 as per IS: 277, in 240 mpa steel grade, 5-7 microns epoxy primer on both side of the sheet and polyester top coat 15-18 microns using self drilling/ self tapping screws complete : Ridges plain (500 - 600mm)

Providing and fixing 15 cm wide, 45 cm overall semi-circular plain G.S. sheet gutter with iron brackets 40x3mm size, bolts, nuts and washers etc., including making necessary connections with rain water pipe
